title: The Dark Knight
cast: Christian Bale Heath Ledger Aaron Eckhart Michael Caine
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Inception
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio Joseph Gordon-Levitt Elliot Page Tom Hardy Ken Watanabe
overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O. but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

title: Interstellar
cast: Matthew McConaughey Anne Hathaway Jessica Chastain Michael Caine
overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival. When Earth becomes uninhabitable farmers and scientists must journey beyond the solar system in search of a new home for mankind.

title: The Matrix
cast: Keanu Reeves Laurence Fishburne Carrie-Anne Moss Hugo Weaving
overview: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers. When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth about the simulated reality he has been living in.

title: Avengers Endgame
cast: Robert Downey Jr Chris Evans Mark Ruffalo Chris Hemsworth Scarlett Johansson
overview: After the devastating events of Infinity War the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos actions and restore balance to the universe.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
cast: Tim Robbins Morgan Freeman Bob Gunton William Sadler
overview: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency. A banker convicted of uxoricide forms a friendship over a quarter century with a hardened convict while maintaining his innocence and trying to remain hopeful through simple compassion.

title: Pulp Fiction
cast: John Travolta Uma Thurman Samuel L Jackson Bruce Willis Harvey Keitel
overview: The lives of two mob hitmen a boxer a gangster and his wife and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption. A series of interconnected stories exploring violence and redemption in Los Angeles criminal underworld.

title: Goodfellas
cast: Ray Liotta Robert De Niro Joe Pesci Lorraine Bracco Paul Sorvino
overview: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob covering his relationship with his wife Karen Hill and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito in the Italian-American crime syndicate.

title: Fight Club
cast: Brad Pitt Edward Norton Helena Bonham Carter Meat Loaf Jared Leto
overview: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soapmaker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more. The first rule of fight club is you do not talk about fight club.

title: Forrest Gump
cast: Tom Hanks Robin Wright Gary Sinise Sally Field
overview: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson the events of Vietnam Watergate and other historical events unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75 whose only desire is to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
cast: Jodie Foster Anthony Hopkins Lawrence A Bonney Kasi Lemmons
overview: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer a madman who skins his victims. The quest to stop a terrifying murderer leads a determined FBI trainee to seek help from an even more dangerous source.

title: Gladiator
cast: Russell Crowe Joaquin Phoenix Connie Nielsen Oliver Reed
overview: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery. A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people.

title: The Lord of the Rings The Fellowship of the Ring
cast: Elijah Wood Ian McKellen Orlando Bloom Sean Bean
overview: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron. An epic quest to defeat the greatest evil in the land.

title: The Lord of the Rings The Two Towers
cast: Elijah Wood Ian McKellen Viggo Mortensen Orlando Bloom
overview: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum the divided fellowship makes a stand against Saruman's army at Helm's Deep. The fellowship is broken but the quest to destroy the One Ring continues.

title: The Lord of the Rings The Return of the King
cast: Elijah Wood Ian McKellen Viggo Mortensen Orlando Bloom
overview: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring. The epic conclusion to the battle for Middle-earth.

title: Titanic
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio Kate Winslet Billy Zane Kathy Bates
overview: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic. A epic romance set against the backdrop of the famous maritime disaster.

title: Avatar
cast: Sam Worthington Zoe Saldana Sigourney Weaver Michelle Rodriguez
overview: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home. An alien world filled with wonder and danger.

title: The Lion King
cast: Matthew Broderick Jeremy Irons James Earl Jones
overview: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle who wants to ascend the throne himself. A young lion cub flees his kingdom only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery.

title: Toy Story
cast: Tom Hanks Tim Allen Don Rickles Jim Varney
overview: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman figure supplants him as top toy in a boy's room. The toys must navigate their way back home before their owner moves.

title: Finding Nemo
cast: Albert Brooks Ellen DeGeneres Alexander Gould Willem Dafoe
overview: After his son is taken by a diver, an overprotective clownfish sets out on a journey across the ocean with a forgetful fish named Dory. A heartwarming adventure about a father's love and the journey to find his missing son.

title: The Avengers
cast: Robert Downey Jr Chris Evans Mark Ruffalo Chris Hemsworth
overview: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity. A superhero team-up film like no other.

title: Iron Man
cast: Robert Downey Jr Gwyneth Paltrow Jeff Bridges Terrence Howard
overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave an industrialist creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil. A billionaire genius builds an armored suit to save the world from those who would exploit his technology.

title: Thor
cast: Chris Hemsworth Anthony Hopkins Natalie Portman Kat Dennings
overview: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders. An Asgardian warrior must prove himself worthy to reclaim his hammer.

title: Captain America The First Avenger
cast: Chris Evans Hugo Weaving Samuel L Jackson Hayley Atwell
overview: Steve Rogers a rejected military soldier transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a Super-Soldier serum. A patriotic super soldier fights the forces of Hydra during World War II.

title: Spider-Man
cast: Tobey Maguire Kirsten Dunst Willem Dafoe James Franco
overview: When bitten by a genetically modified spider a nerdy shy and awkward high school student gains spider-like abilities that he eventually must use to fight evil as a superhero. A young hero discovers his destiny as New York's protector.

title: Black Panther
cast: Chadwick Boseman Michael B Jordan Lupita Nyongo Danai Gurira
overview: T'Challa heir to the hidden but advanced kingdom of Wakanda must step forward to lead his people into a new future and must confront a challenger from his country's past. A king rises to protect his nation and the world.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
cast: Chris Pratt Vin Diesel Bradley Cooper Zoe Saldana
overview: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe. A misfit group of heroes must work together to save the galaxy.

title: Doctor Strange
cast: Benedict Cumberbatch Chiwetel Ejiofor Rachel McAdams Benedict Wong
overview: While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts. A surgeon discovers the world of magic and becomes its protector.

title: Joker
cast: Joaquin Phoenix Robert De Niro Zazie Beetz Frances Conroy
overview: In Gotham City mentally troubled comedian Arthur Fleck is disregarded and mistreated by society. He then embarks on a downward spiral of revolution and bloody crime. The origin story of the iconic Batman villain.

title: Parasite
cast: Song Kang-ho Lee Sun-kyun Cho Yeo-jeong Choi Woo-shik
overview: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. A poor family infiltrates a wealthy household with unexpected consequences.

title: Get Out
cast: Daniel Kaluuya Allison Williams Bradley Whitford Catherine Keener
overview: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend. When a series of disturbing discoveries lead to unsettling truths he has to look for a way to escape. A terrifying social thriller about race in America.

title: A Quiet Place
cast: Emily Blunt John Krasinski Millicent Simmonds Noah Jupe
overview: In a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by blind monsters with an acute sense of hearing a family struggles to survive. They must live in near silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound alone.

title: Hereditary
cast: Toni Collette Alex Wolff Milly Shapiro Ann Dowd
overview: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away her daughter's family begins to unravel cryptic and terrifying secrets about their ancestry. A family discovers the horrifying secrets of their lineage.

title: The Conjuring
cast: Patrick Wilson Vera Farmiga Ron Livingston Lili Taylor
overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Based on the true story of one of the most terrifying cases from their files.

title: It
cast: Bill Skarsgard Jaeden Martell Finn Wolfhard Sophia Lillis
overview: In the summer of 1989 a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of Derry their small Maine town. Seven kids face their deepest fears.

title: The Notebook
cast: Ryan Gosling Rachel McAdams James Garner Gena Rowlands
overview: A poor yet passionate young man falls in love with a rich young woman giving her a sense of freedom, but they are soon separated because of their social differences. A timeless love story spanning decades.

title: La La Land
cast: Ryan Gosling Emma Stone John Legend Rosemarie DeWitt
overview: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future. A modern musical about dreamers chasing their dreams in Hollywood.

title: Casablanca
cast: Humphrey Bogart Ingrid Bergman Paul Henreid Claude Rains
overview: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether or not to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape French Morocco. A classic wartime romance filled with passion and sacrifice.

title: Pride and Prejudice
cast: Keira Knightley Matthew Macfadyen Brenda Blethyn Donald Sutherland
overview: Sparks fly when spirited Elizabeth Bennet meets single, rich, and proud Mr. Darcy. But Mr. Darcy reluctantly finds himself falling in love with a woman beneath his class. A beloved Jane Austen adaptation.

title: 500 Days of Summer
cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt Zooey Deschanel Geoffrey Arend Chloe Moretz
overview: An offbeat romantic comedy about a woman who doesn't believe true love exists and the young man who falls for her. A non-linear love story about expectations versus reality in modern romance.

title: The Social Network
cast: Jesse Eisenberg Andrew Garfield Justin Timberlake Rooney Mara
overview: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook he is sued by the twins who claim he stole their idea and by the co-founder who was later squeezed out of the business.

title: Moneyball
cast: Brad Pitt Jonah Hill Philip Seymour Hoffman Robin Wright
overview: Oakland A's general manager Billy Beane's successful attempt to assemble a baseball team on a lean budget by employing computer-generated analysis to acquire new players.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio Jonah Hill Margot Robbie Kyle Chandler
overview: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort a stockbroker in New York City in the early 1990s. He rose to wealth in the financial world but then as quickly fell into a life of corruption crime and the federal government.

title: Whiplash
cast: Miles Teller J K Simmons Melissa Benoist Paul Reiser
overview: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential. The relentless pursuit of perfection.

title: Bohemian Rhapsody
cast: Rami Malek Lucy Boynton Gwilym Lee Ben Hardy
overview: The story of the legendary rock band Queen and lead singer Freddie Mercury leading up to their famous performance at Live Aid. A celebration of music ambition and the price of fame.

title: The Martian
cast: Matt Damon Jessica Chastain Kristen Wiig Jeff Daniels
overview: An astronaut becomes stranded on Mars after his team assume him dead, and must rely on his ingenuity to find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive. Survival science fiction at its finest.

title: Gravity
cast: Sandra Bullock George Clooney Ed Harris
overview: A medical engineer and an astronaut work together to survive after a catastrophe destroys their shuttle and leaves them adrift in orbit. Breathtaking survival thriller set in the vacuum of space.

title: 2001 A Space Odyssey
cast: Keir Dullea Gary Lockwood William Sylvester Daniel Richter
overview: After discovering a mysterious artifact buried beneath the Lunar surface mankind sets off on a quest to find its origins with help from intelligent supercomputer H.A.L. 9000. A landmark of science fiction cinema.

title: The Terminator
cast: Arnold Schwarzenegger Linda Hamilton Michael Biehn Paul Winfield
overview: A human-looking indestructible cyborg is sent from 2029 to 1984 to assassinate a waitress whose unborn son will lead humanity in a war against the machines while a soldier from that war is sent to protect her. A sci-fi classic about time travel and survival.

title: Mad Max Fury Road
cast: Tom Hardy Charlize Theron Nicholas Hoult Hugh Keays-Byrne
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners a psychotic worshiper and a drifter named Max. A non-stop adrenaline fueled chase across the wasteland.
